overview.description: The Hotchkis & Wiley International Value Fund ETF (HWIV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in value companies across the market cap spectrum from developed markets outside of the United States. HWIV was launched on Jul 22, 2026 and is issued by Hotchkis & Wiley.

data.title: Hotchkis & Wiley Launches ETF Share Classes for International Value Fund and Opportunities Fund
data.text: LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Global investment manager Hotchkis & Wiley launches new ETF share classes for two existing mutual funds with HWIV and HWO.
